expected: the approving actor independently verifies the current affected scope
known_bad_detection_method: The chair replayed historical pre-fix and fresh 210eb stamps. The old digest triggered setup_inputs_changed. A fresh digest passed a notes edit and failed a real setting change. A rename fixture also undercounted four paths as three after the source endpoint was omitted.
limitations: Readiness establishes the plan and historical controls. Production effectiveness and elapsed savings are unmeasured.

The red-team traced the missed compatibility claim in 210eb. Architecture, security and QA detected the omitted individual-close route. Reality, docs-contract and code reviewers replayed the old stamp through its consumer. The chair showed existing delivery approval can survive an ordinary same-member policy rotation, which justifies 240t6's explicit fresh-approval rule after escalation. The strongest alternative adds a consumer trace and an existing-state check to the single review. 2136q establishes the documented decision and follow-up. Meeting 240t6 AC-1–5 establishes the operator path and wave objective. After release, measured findings and effort, queue and suite time, scope escalations and close outcomes can be compared.
proposition: council-readiness approves the current affected scope
